meta.title: Two vendors with the same price
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the existing prepared RFQ event summary as the buyer.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Navigate to the Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Check whether the first equal-price vendor receives the expected Rank 1.
Check whether the second equal-price vendor also receives the expected Rank 1; a displayed Rank 2 exposes the known tie-ranking defect.
Verify each vendor's line amount equals rate times quantity and each total equals the sum of its line amounts.
Verify the first vendor's displayed rate matches the prepared bid price.
Verify the second vendor's displayed rate matches the prepared bid price.
Verify the first vendor's displayed total matches the prepared bid total.
Verify the second vendor's displayed total matches the prepared bid total.
